deals.evidence: integralizadas pelo CAM na proporção de 25% e pela Galo Holding S.A. na proporção de 75%.
deals.headline: Galo Holding takes 75% of Atlético Mineiro SAF
deals.investor: Galo Holding S.A. (Rubens and Rafael Menin, Ricardo Guimarães, Renato Salvador)
deals.source_name: Atlético Mineiro S.A.F. 2025 financial statements, note 1.1
deals.summary: Investment and shareholders' agreements of 1 November 2023: the association contributed the football department (men's and women's teams, Cidade do Galo, Arena MRV) to the SAF and Galo Holding entered with 75%. Per note 2.5 the capital increase was paid R$316.280m by conversion of the subscriber's credits, R$505.903m in cash, and R$94.097m due within three years. No single purchase price is stated in the accounts.

deals.evidence: A receita de Direitos de Transmissão e Premiações considerou o valor de R$98M decorrentes da venda dos direitos de participação da LFU (Liga Forte União).
deals.headline: Atlético books R$98m from sale of LFU participation rights
deals.seller: Liga Forte União clubs incl. Atlético Mineiro
deals.summary: 2025 TV and prize revenue included R$98m from the sale of participation rights in Liga Forte União (Brasileirão commercial-rights league).

deals.evidence: a SAF estruturou um Fundo de Investimento em Direitos Creditórios (FIDC) que captou R$ 90 milhões em sua primeira emissão em meados de dezembro
deals.headline: Atlético SAF raises R$90m in first FIDC issue
deals.summary: To address short-term debt the SAF set up a credit-receivables investment fund (FIDC) that raised R$90m in its first issuance in mid-December 2025.

deals.evidence: Agora, Rubens Menin e Rafael Menin aumentaram suas ações em 41,7%, saindo de 41,8% para 83,5%.
deals.headline: Menin family's R$530m capital injection lifts stake to 83.5%
deals.investor: Rubens Menin and Rafael Menin (via Galo Holding S.A.)
deals.summary: The association's deliberative council approved a R$530m injection (about R$436.9m capital increase via new Galo Holding shares plus ~R$94m via FIGA brought forward), mostly to repay bank debt. The Menins rose from 41.8% to 83.5%; the association fell from 25% to 10%; Vorcaro (Galo Forte FIP), Guimarães and FIGA to 6.5%.

The statutory 2025 net loss of R$882.1m includes a R$572.2m fair-value loss; the management view shows a R$310m loss. Net-debt chart figures are in R$ millions (the unit label is on adjacent pages, not in the chart's text). Social figure is stated as '+10 milhões' (more than 10 million) across main platforms in 2025. Chair evidence spans two lines on the governance page. Shirt sponsor not recorded: H2Bet was a 2025 partner, and Lance! (late Sept 2026) headlines the club losing H2bet amid the end of betting sponsorships; kit supplier not confirmed on a citable page (Nike appears in the 2025 partner list without role). Arena MRV attendance is published only as an all-time average (31,287), not per season.

ownership_summary: Football is run by Atlético Mineiro S.A.F., formed in 2023; on 1 November 2023 Galo Holding S.A. (Rubens and Rafael Menin, Ricardo Guimarães, Renato Salvador, with Daniel Vorcaro also in the structure) took 75% and the association 25%. After a R$530m capital increase approved on 25 May 2026, Rubens and Rafael Menin hold 83.5%, the association 10%, and Ricardo Guimarães, Daniel Vorcaro (Galo Forte FIP) and the Fundo de Investimentos do Galo (FIGA) about 6.5% combined.
